User decisions 2026-10-01: D2 revive learning because these fixes should have gone through learning to stop repeated and future problems early; D3 keep codex-role-setup.py --apply as an exception because Codex breaks model selection without explicit registration. User also pointed out that the Codex learning change had not been read or reviewed before judging it.

P1: execution-record.py now requires a learning-assessment before finalize for debugging/homeostasis routes, learningRequired/confirmedDefect, or user-correction/user-reported-correction/verifier-failure/replay-failure/review-finding facts; opt-out needs learningOptOut. Assessments need a registered signature (vascular-bundle_circulation/failure-signatures.json, 7 ids), append to learning-ledger.jsonl, and a signature seen in another work needs an existing --guard and cannot be closed-no-learning. learning-scan reports occurrences, works, guards. verify-learning-contract checks the registry and ledger. The registry verifier rejects a done row in the active plan without a passed record and an evidence class. Ledger seeded with 14 occurrences across 6 recurring signatures and 1 single.

P2 measure: 26 Claude replay sessions (small tasks) read execution-allocation.md 3 times, delivery.md once, conductor never, no skill invoked. In this large interactive session conductor, debugging, execution-allocation and the homeostasis skill were read and followed. Rule markdown: skills 12,800 lines (hallmark 9,778) load on demand; orchestration docs about 2,200 lines, most anchored by verifiers or referenced by active docs. Only capability-lifecycle.md (27) and xylem-context.md (10) had no reader, tool, or reference; their content duplicates skill-lifecycle/admission-policy and context-packet. Removed (restorable from git at 9c68504). Orchestration line budget 2,138 enforced by verify-runtime-entrypoint.py.

Corrections to the Claude evaluation of 2026-10-01: (1) 'most of 15k rule lines never reach behavior' overstated: 12,800 lines are on-demand skills; the orchestration policy is about 2,200 lines. (2) F21 'sessions never read route docs' holds for small replay tasks only; large interactive work read and followed them. Both are conclusions stronger than their sample.

topic: How much to prune in phase 2
observations: orchestration docs are about 2,200 lines, most anchored by verifiers or referenced by active docs
only two docs had no reader, tool, or reference
large interactive work does read route docs
options: remove verifier-anchored docs that small tasks do not read
remove only unreferenced docs and stop growth with a line budget
selected: remove the two unreferenced docs and enforce a 2,138-line budget
rationale: Small-task replays do not represent large work, so deleting docs that large work reads would trade measured savings for unmeasured harm.
reviewTrigger: Large-task sessions are measured and show a doc unread, or the budget blocks a needed rule.
